file: 13- HR Skills for Non HR Professionals.docx
title: HR Skills for Non-HR Professionals
overview: This course is designed to provide line managers with essential HR skills to help them manage their teams more effectively. It covers key HR functions such as employee interviews, onboarding, performance appraisals, training, and handling grievances. By equipping line managers with these skills, they can better support their employees and contribute to organizational success.
audience: This course is ideal for line managers, department heads, team leaders, supervisors, and anyone looking to enhance their understanding of HR practices and how to apply them effectively within their teams or departments.
methodology: Each day of the course focuses on a different HR topic relevant to line managers. Participants will engage in group exercises, role-playing, video presentations, and practical case studies. This interactive approach ensures that managers and department heads gain practical knowledge to help them achieve organizational goals through effective people management.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand and apply key HR functions relevant to managers
Define the role of managers in recruitment and onboarding processes
Identify and assess training needs effectively
Manage employee complaints, grievances, and reduce turnover
